study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition (EPIC)
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Concentrations of the isoflavone genistein were measured in prediagnostic plasma samples for 1,605 prostate cancer cases and 1,697 matched control participants.
reason: The abstract analyzes incident overall prostate cancer. Although it mentions heterogeneity by cancer stage and histological grade, it does not explicitly define or report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Plasma genistein concentrations were not associated with prostate cancer risk; the multivariate relative risk for men in the highest fifth of genistein compared with men in the lowest fifth was 1.00 (95 % confidence interval: 0.79, 1.27; p linear trend = 0.82).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is explicitly for overall prostate cancer risk, not an aggressive subtype.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
